c_toolchain_ephemeral.name: Ephemeral C/C++ Build Toolchain
c_toolchain_ephemeral.prepareCommand: sudo apk add --no-cache --virtual .build-deps build-base cmake pkgconfig

pure_go_static.name: Pure Go Static Binary Build
pure_go_static.prepareCommand: sudo apk add --no-cache go git ca-certificates

rust_musl_static.name: Rust Static Compilation for Alpine
rust_musl_static.prepareCommand: sudo apk add --no-cache rust cargo musl-dev

system_diagnostics.name: Alpine Network Inspection & Diagnostics
system_diagnostics.prepareCommand: sudo apk add --no-cache curl bind-tools busybox-extras iputils htop
